main_text.p: libus, atque æqua eum pati coegisset, exules quidem restituti in integrum sunt: sed eodem, domi cùm dominatum struueret, àsuis vicissim in ordinem redacto, Ailco cum HamburgensibusFocconianarum partium hostibus Emdam tum tenentibus societate junƈta, auxilio eorum exules rursum exturbarat oppresseratvé; deinde ut gratum novis sociis faceret,& suas res proveheret, societati civitatis Groninganæ,& iis quæ societatem sequebantur, se cœpit obiicere. Mox exemplum vicinum Ripperdæorum metuens, & simul ab exulibus formidinem habens, ac injuriarum in diversos, adeoque in oppidanos sibi conscius, præsidium sociorum in arcem suam recepit. Eo fretus liberiùs jam societatem & pacta conventa cum Groninganis turbare, commercia impedire, negotiantibus infestus esse. inter Hamburgenses quoque & Groninganos simultas & odia asperari. Intereà & Eppo Gockinga Aiuoldi filius in ea Præfecturæ veteris parte, qua ager palustris & nemorofus est, quæ in Austrum vergit, apud Suidbrocæos sedem habens,

page.notes: Running head read as "Deque Vrbe Groninga." and normalised to "Deque Urbe Groninga." under the u/v rule. Uncertain readings: "Intereà" (accent may be printed or a smudge). The word "Hamburgensibus" and "Focconianarum" run together at the line end as printed ("HamburgensibusFocconiana-rum"); the join is printed without a space, so it is kept as one token. Ligature "ƈ" in "junƈta" is the ct ligature as printed. The scan shows a show-through of the page on the reverse, which is not transcribed; the Google watermark at bottom right is not transcribed.
